name: agent-swarm
description: Agent Swarm system with MCP server integration and orchestrator agent

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:packages
scripts.build:extensions: npm run compile --workspace=@agent-swarm/vscode-extension --if-present && npm run compile --workspace=@agent-swarm/cursor-extension --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run build:api && concurrently -n "CORE,API,WEB" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start:api && npm run start:web
scripts.clean: npm run clean:core && npm run clean:packages
scripts.clean:core: cd src && rm -rf dist || rmdir /s /q dist || true
